Tested in a private copy, /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-naira-scroll/81f6e48f-a340-5398-99b2-f7e22fb69d37/scratchpad/review6/tools/comp_prism_v7.py: the installed comp_prism.py plus one option. The render is /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-naira-scroll/81f6e48f-a340-5398-99b2-f7e22fb69d37/scratchpad/review6/var/r3_clamp.png, made with python3 -B comp_prism_v7.py footclamp=1.
(1) footclamp: just before `band = P["band"]`, stop the front foot from lying below the piece's own lowest pixel in each column:
has = A.max(0) > .5; xi = np.arange(W)
lowA = ((H - 1) - np.argmax((A > .5)[::-1], axis=0)).astype(np.float32)
lowA = np.interp(xi, xi[has], lowA[has])
lowA = np.convolve(np.pad(lowA, 3, mode="edge"), np.ones(7) / 7, "valid")
cl = has & (yf[0] > lowA + 1); yf = yf.copy(); yf[0, cl] = lowA[cl] + 1
It moves the foot at x 130-199 only, by up to 84 px. Elsewhere it moves at most 1.8 px (x 213-224 and 721-723), plus the hidden tip at x 800-804. The gap under the end links becomes 0 px at every column from x 136 to 202. Fidelity (0.946), the front shadow, the double-shadow region, the mattes and sharpness are unchanged.
(2) Optional, untested: grow the pink matte 2 px over x 715-730, y 1450-1475 to cover the link's dark edge.
(3) For 10: hard sun glints on the back-left corners of the link tops and on the prongs, and shade on the back links' camera-facing walls. These need a listing shot under a hard back-left light; a 2-D relight cannot place them.
